name: Garlic Butter Pan-Seared Chicken with Avocado Salsa
pitch: Juicy pan-seared chicken topped with a simple smashed avocado salsa — it's fresh, fast, and feels a little fancy for a weeknight.
steps: Season chicken breasts or thighs generously with salt, pepper, and a pinch of garlic powder on both sides.

Heat a tablespoon of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken 5–7 minutes per side until golden and cooked through, then add a knob of butter and a minced garlic clove to the pan and spoon it over the chicken for the last minute.

While the chicken rests, mash the avocado with a pinch of salt, pepper, and a small splash of vinegar (white or apple cider) to brighten it up — this stands in nicely for lime juice if you don't have it.
Slice the chicken, spoon the avocado on top, and serve. Simple as that.

name: Soy-Glazed Chicken Rice Bowl with Avocado
pitch: A comforting, Asian-inspired bowl with sticky soy-glazed chicken and creamy avocado slices — this one is simple but genuinely satisfying.
steps: Cook rice according to package directions (this is your longest step, so start it first).
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with pepper. Cook in a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes until cooked through.
Mix together 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 teaspoon vinegar, a minced garlic clove, and a pinch of sugar if you have it. Pour over the cooked chicken and toss for 1–2 minutes until glazed and sticky.
Slice the avocado. Serve the glazed chicken over rice with avocado on the side, and drizzle any extra glaze from the pan over the bowl.

name: Crispy Chicken & Avocado Flatbread Pizza
pitch: Think of this as a lazy, no-fuss pizza — toasted bread piled with seasoned chicken and avocado, it's fun and kid-friendly.
steps: Cook chicken (sliced thin or pounded flat) in a skillet with oil, salt, pepper, and garlic until golden and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. Let it rest, then slice or chop it.
Toast your flatbread, pita, or sliced sandwich bread in the oven at 400°F for 5 minutes until just crisp.
Mash avocado with salt, pepper, and a splash of vinegar and spread it generously over the toasted bread as your 'sauce.'
Top with the sliced chicken, add any extra spices you like (a pinch of chili flakes or cumin is great here), and serve immediately while the bread is still crispy.
